entradas.text: I had recently signed the Emergency Act, which created a ruckus in the Sordish Police Forces and the Grand National Assembly.
Now it was time to make a speech in the Assembly and declare the emergency in public.
I walked with quick steps in the corridors of the Grand National Assembly, giving my greetings to the people I encountered on my way towards the parliamentary hall.
When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the center of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.
<shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>
Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.
"Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."
Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.
"Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."
"We have the President here with us today. He has an important declaration to make."
I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.
"Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"
She pointed at me with her hand.
"The President has the floor."
The Assembly fell silent.
I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.
"Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to present an important decision of the State concerning the recent troubling developments in Sordland."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and Gentlemen..."

entradas.text: "Sordland has gone through a critical day on January when Bernard Circas was shot by a militant member of the Young Sords. That day marked the beginning of terror against Sordland and its citizens."
entradas.menu: Focus on the shooting of Bernard Circas.

entradas.text: "Sordland is going through critical times! The clashes between extremist political organizations have taken their fights to the streets and started threatening the national security of our country."
entradas.menu: Focus on the clashes between the Red Youth and Young Sords.

entradas.text: "Sordland has long been plagued by Bludish separatist groups inside our borders. Their threat, however, has never been greater. They have been heavily arming themselves with military aid from Rumburg against Sordland!"
entradas.menu: Focus on the Bludish Freedom Front and Rumburg's aid.

entradas.text: I brought attention to...
I brought attention to...
I brought attention to...

"Young Sords and their actions against the public and the State can no longer be tolerated. Thus, the Sordish ultranationalist movement must be regarded as a national security threat from today onwards."
entradas.menu: The threat of the Young Sords and the right wing agenda.

entradas.text: "Sordland is clearly experiencing a dangerous civil strife between left and right wing extremist groups, which put our citizens lives in danger and act against our State in hopes of toppling our government. Today we find ourselves in a time of emergency."
entradas.menu: The threat of extreme left and right wing groups in Sordland.

entradas.text: "Red Youth and their actions against the public and the State can no longer be tolerated. Thus, the Sordish communist movement must be regarded as a national security threat from today onwards."
entradas.menu: The threat of the Red Youth and the left wing agenda.

entradas.text: "All Bludish separatist groups and the supporters of Bludish Freedom Front must be regarded as national security threats from today onwards. Sordland can no longer harbour these paramilitary organizations who plans to attack our sovereign nation."
entradas.menu: The threat of the Bludish separatists.

entradas.text: "With the armament of the BFF, Rumburg has shown a clear aggressive stance against Sordland. They pose a major national security threat for our country. We must stay strong and be ready against their treacherous actions."
entradas.menu: The threat of Rumburg.

entradas.text: Applauses came from the NFP seats.
Applauses came from the NFP seats.
The opposition members started yelling in protest.
NFP members started yelling in protest.

"On top of that, we have found that the Bludish separatists are planning to occupy the region of Bergia and form a new nation inside our borders. Therefore, the State has decided to take extraordinary measures to handle these threats swiftly."
entradas.menu: Blame the Bludish separatists for a plan to occupy Bergia.

entradas.text: "On top of that, we have found that the communists are planning to stage a communist revolution in Sordland by toppling our government. Therefore, the State has decided to take extraordinary measures to handle these threats swiftly."
entradas.menu: Blame the communists for a plan to overthrow the government.

entradas.text: "On top of that, we have found that the ultranationalists are planning to overthrow our government and bring a totalist maximist state. Therefore, the State has decided to take extraordinary measures to handle these threats swiftly."
entradas.menu: Blame the ultranationalists for a plan to overthrow the government.

entradas.text: "The foreign powers are to be blamed! They are disrespecting the sovereignty of our nation and agitate and support these extremist groups against our country in hopes of toppling our government to establish a puppet state. The State will now react swiftly to these threats."
entradas.menu: Blame foreign powers for supporting extremist groups.

entradas.text: "The police will be given increased authority in regard to their use of force. Searching civilians and orders for confiscations will be permissible beyond their legal limits for the duration of the Emergency period."
entradas.menu: "The police will be given increased authority..."

entradas.text: "Surveillance capabilities of the State will be increased beyond their limits until further notice."
entradas.menu: "Surveillance capabilities of the State will be increased..."

entradas.text: "Suspects will not require a trial to be detained if said crime endangers the State and the wellbeing of its citizens."
entradas.menu: "Suspects will not require a trial to be detained..."

entradas.text: "The right to assemble in protest will be suspended for the duration of the Emergency. All citizens are expected to abide by the law and the police is given permission to use force against assembled crowds."
entradas.menu: "The right to assemble in protest will be suspended..."

entradas.text: "In accordance with Article 57 and 58 of the Constitution, the State holds the right to order for these measures to be taken in a situation of emergency like we have today."
entradas.menu: "In accordance with Article 57..."

entradas.text: There was a loud reaction from the Assembly.
"The President has not finished!"
Gloria hit the gavel again.
Mansoun Leke, a Bludish MP, who was regarded as the leader of the independents, jumped from his seat and started shouting at me.
<shout>"THIS IS TOTALISM!"</shout>
"These measures, although extraordinary, were completely necessary for us to take. We must be vigilant as a nation in times of crisis and surely we will be triumphant."
entradas.menu: Continue with the speech.

entradas.text: I found a time to take a breather during the loud commotion.
"Can you please be quiet when I'm speaking, Mr. Leke?"
entradas.menu: "Can you please be quiet when I'm speaking, Mr. Leke?"

entradas.text: I continued among applauses from the USP seats.
"Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

entradas.text: "We will be resuming with our foreign policy as usual during this period of Emergency."
"In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with Rumburg for their treacherous actions. We will be responding with an embargo."
"In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with United Contana for their treacherous actions. We will be responding with an embargo."
"Same measures will also be taken against United Contana..."
"In accordance with the Emergency Act, Sordland will sever all diplomatic ties with Arcasia for their actions of treason against Sordland. We will be responding with an embargo."
"Same measures will also be taken against Arcasia."
"Sordland will stand alone if needs be. Whatever the case may be, we must be strong."
"...And Arcasia."
"We must be strong as a nation and preserve our connections."
I paused and took a look at the Assembly.
"Today, we must fight for Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "Today, we must fight for Sordland!"

entradas.text: "I ask everyone to understand our situation."
entradas.menu: "I ask everyone to understand our situation."

entradas.text: "We must finally be brave and strike down the red threat!"
entradas.menu: "We must finally be brave and strike down the red threat!"

entradas.text: USP seats applauded.
"I ask everybody to be patient."
entradas.menu: "I ask everybody to be patient."

entradas.text: "We will fight against the maximists together!"
entradas.menu: "We will fight against the maximists together!"

entradas.text: "I assure you that this period will not last long."
entradas.menu: "I assure you that this period will not last long."

entradas.text: "We will eliminate all who oppose the State!"
entradas.menu: "We will eliminate all who oppose the State!"

entradas.text: "We ask for everybody's cooperation and support."
entradas.menu: "We ask for everybody's cooperation and support."

entradas.text: "The State will swiftly address the situation."
entradas.menu: "The State will swiftly address the situation."

entradas.text: "The Bludish Issue will finally be addressed!"
entradas.menu: "The Bludish Issue will finally be addressed!"

entradas.text: "Blud separatists will soon be eradicated!"
entradas.menu: "Blud separatists will soon be eradicated!"

entradas.text: I saluted the crowd.
"For a free Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a free Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For a strong Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a strong Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For peace in Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For peace in Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For the legacy of Soll!"
entradas.menu: "For the legacy of Soll!"

entradas.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.
While most of the USP members applauded, all of the opposition yelled in protest as I left the stand.
The sounds of protest gradually increased as I walked towards my seat.
"Thank you for the announcement, Mr. President."
Mansoun Leke started yelling at me again.
<shout>"YOU ARE JUST LIKE SOLL!"</shout>
<shout>"LEAVE BLUDISH PEOPLE ALONE!"</shout>
Kesaro stood up from his seat and walked closer to me and yelled at me.
<shout>"This is a mistake, Mr. President! How dare you target the nationalists?"</shout>
<shout>"Young Sords are a group of people who love their country and Sordish culture! They are not the enemies!"</shout>
Kesaro stood up from his seat and yelled back at Mansoun.
<shout>"YOU LIVE IN SORDLAND, MR. LEKE!"</shout>
<shout>"YOU CANNOT FIGHT AGAINST THIS COUNTRY AND EXPECT IT NOT TO REACT!"</shout>
Mansoun Leke started yelling at me again.
<shout>"Wasn't it enough that the ultranationalists murdered Bernard Circas in cold blood!?"</shout>
<shout>"Now you are declaring a war against the left! You are just like Soll, Mr. President!"</shout>
<shout>"A cold blooded nationalist!"</shout>
Gloria started hitting the gavel again when the situation escalated further.
Kesaro stood up from his seat and yelled back at Mansoun.
<shout>"HOW DARE YOU TALK LIKE THAT IN HERE?"</shout>
<shout>"YOU LIVE IN SORDLAND, MR. LEKE!"</shout>
<shout>"ORDER!"</shout>
"Gentlemen, when will you learn to behave like adults?"
Once I was sure the Assembly's attention was on Gloria, I left the hall.
I walked back to the Palace in silence.
"Honorable Members of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to present an important decision of the State concerning the recent troubling developments in Sordland."
entradas.menu: "Honorable Members of Assembly..."

entradas.text: "Brothers and sisters! I am here today to present an important decision of the State concerning the recent troubling developments in Sordland."
entradas.menu: "Brothers and sisters..."

entradas.text: "On the basis of said Articles, I hereby declare a state of emergency and order the Emergency Act's swift execution."
entradas.menu: "On the basis of said Articles, I hereby declare a state of emergency and order the Emergency Act's swift execution."

entradas.text: "I hereby declare a state of emergency in Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "I hereby declare a state of emergency in Sordland!"

entradas.text: "Show some respect!"
entradas.menu: "Show some respect!"
